summary: Starfield entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Starfield
entries.definitive_edition: Starfield on Windows PC (current patched release)

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows version with current patches and known settings/fixes where needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Highest: native PC route with modern resolution, display, and settings flexibility.

primary.version: Starfield on Windows PC (current patched release)
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity practical route among the available platforms: native PC output, known PC configuration options, and access to the current patched game content. The PS5 release adds DualSense and PS5 Pro presentation features, but the Free Lanes update and Terran Armada DLC go live across all platforms rather than being PS5-exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam or Xbox PC version on Windows with current patches; apply known fixes/settings as needed, prefer native resolution/VRR where available, and keep official content parity with the console releases.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster split. PS5-specific DualSense and PS5 Pro modes are presentation/control features, not separate story content requiring a second route.
